stem: Jobs such as the ones described in this 1956 advertisement became available because —

options.label: A
options.text: federal law required private businesses to recruit for the military

options.label: B
options.text: weak college programs had produced few scientists qualified for high-level research

options.label: C
options.text: Cold War defense programs had spurred technological innovation

options.label: D
options.text: most U.S. citizens opposed the development of atomic weapons

visual_elements: Picture of a young man planning a successful future with a brochure titled 'Your Future in Guided Missiles With Bendix'

Text box: Success doesn’t just happen to a company or to an individual. Success comes as a result of clear thinking and long-range planning. And that is just what the young engineer in the picture is doing. He is studying the many possibilities of a career in guided missiles.
